title: Security logs: hourly shipment and review
caption: deploy/scripts/ship-logs.sh (:05) and log-review.sh (:20). Each keeps its own journald cursor; the WAF's query values are blanked before anything leaves the VM.

steps.label: entries after cursor: sshd, sudo, auditd, caddy access + WAF, egress denies, fail2ban, AIDE, velexis-* ≥ warning, security events
one JSON line each {ts,rt,host,cat,unit,ident,pid,uid,prio,msg}; blank [uri] query values
zstd + age (data key) + rclone copy --immutable; rclone check
only after the check: move cursor, append to the UTC day's file (kept 90 days)
immediately: root login, new SSH key, change under /etc/velexis/keys, AIDE change outside a deploy, aide-error, aide-stale, shipment failing, egress burst ≥ 30, folder > 5 GB
first run at or after 06:00 UTC: 'security log review <date>: …' summary
